tag: 進料檢驗員臨時聘用建議電子郵件

level.why: 電子郵件含原因子句、關係子句與被動語態，需整合聘用理由、檢驗職責與薪資安排；字彙為品管與進料檢驗相關詞彙，干擾項取自文中提到的職責與薪資資訊。

passage:
To: Karen Mills, Plant Executive
From: Daniel Wu, Quality Control Manager
Subject: Temporary Incoming Materials Inspector

Dear Ms. Mills,

Because the number of incoming material shipments is expected to double before the holiday season, I recommend hiring one temporary inspector to work at the receiving dock. Mr. Tom Reyes, who applied last week, has practical experience in checking steel components, and his reference letter from a former plant executive confirms that he is careful and reliable. He also shows strong self-motivation, which matters because he will work with little supervision.

His main duties will be to confirm that each mill certificate is authentic, to inspect every delivery for damage, and to look inside truck compartments for loose or poorly packed items. He will also handle specially ordered alloys, which require a second inspection. Extra hours will be listed separately on his paycheck.

Please let me know by Friday whether you approve.
zh:
收件人：凱倫．米爾斯，工廠主管
寄件人：丹尼爾．吳，品管經理
主旨：臨時進料檢驗員

米爾斯女士您好：

由於假期旺季前進料的貨運量預計將增加一倍，我建議聘請一名臨時檢驗員到收貨碼頭工作。上週應徵的湯姆．雷耶斯先生具有檢查鋼製零件的實務經驗，而他的前任工廠主管所寫的推薦信也證實他細心可靠。他同時展現出強烈的自我驅動力，這點很重要，因為他將在很少人監督的情況下工作。

他的主要職責是確認每一份原廠證明書是真品、檢查每批貨物有無損壞，並查看貨車貨艙內是否有鬆脫或包裝不良的物品。他也會處理特別訂製的合金，這類產品需要進行第二次檢驗。額外的工時會另外列在他的薪資單上。

請在週五前告訴我您是否同意。

vocab.col: receive a paycheck / on the paycheck

questions.q: Why does the writer recommend hiring a temporary inspector?
opts: Incoming shipments are expected to increase sharply
Customers have complained about defective products
A new alloy supplier has been selected
why: 錯誤：文中沒有提到前任檢驗員離職。
正解：假期旺季前進料貨運量預計增加一倍。
錯誤：文中沒有提到客戶抱怨瑕疵品。
錯誤：文中沒有提到更換合金供應商。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as one of Mr. Reyes's duties?
opts: Confirming that mill certificates are authentic
Checking the inside of truck compartments
why: 錯誤：確認原廠證明書為真品是主要職責之一。
錯誤：檢查每批貨物有無損壞是主要職責之一。
錯誤：查看貨車貨艙內的物品是職責之一。
正解：文中沒有提到與供應商議價。

questions.q: What is stated about Mr. Reyes's extra hours?
opts: They will be paid as a year-end bonus
They will be exchanged for days off
They will be listed separately on his paycheck
They must be approved by his former employer
why: 錯誤：文中沒有提到年終獎金。
錯誤：文中沒有提到以工時換休假。
正解：額外工時將另外列在他的薪資單上。
錯誤：前任雇主只負責出具推薦信，與工時無關。

questions.q: All incoming materials must be inspected ______ they are sent to the production line.
why: 錯誤：despite 後接名詞，且語意不符。
錯誤：unless 表示「除非」，語意不通。
錯誤：whereas 表示對比，語意不符。
正解：before 引導時間子句，表示「在…之前」。

questions.q: The supplier's ______ to meet the quality standards led to the rejection of the entire batch.
why: 正解：所有格 supplier's 之後需名詞，failure 意為「未能」。
錯誤：fail 為動詞原形，不能接在所有格後。
錯誤：failed 為過去式或分詞，不能作名詞。
錯誤：failing 作名詞時指「缺點」，語意與後面 to 不符。
